chapter.title: Public Enemy
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the PowerPyx 100% chart (70 nodes, three bracketed phases, eight endings) and the game’s text (the detroitbecometext template resolved against the string table). FALL IN THE ZEN GARDEN → TALK TO AMANDA (four rounds; the third only if the Tracis were spared) → INSIDE STRATFORD TOWER (HANK CONFISCATES COIN unless Hank shot Connor in The Bridge; LISTEN TO BRIEFING) → [ INVESTIGATE CORRIDORS ] → MEET PERKINS → (MEET COP FROM HOSTAGE SITUATION) → [ INVESTIGATE BROADCAST ROOM ] → DECIDE TO LEAVE (CONNOR AND HANK LEFT THE CRIME SCENE) | GO TO ROOFTOP → [ INVESTIGATE ROOFTOP ] → FIND SIMON → RUSH DEVIANT (SHOT BY SIMON → CONNOR DIED RUNNING TOWARD SIMON | REACH SIMON → CONNOR WAS TRAUMATIZED) | STAY IN COVER (HANK AND CONNOR SURVIVED UNSCATHED) | ENTER THE KITCHEN → INTERROGATE ANDROIDS → DEVIANT NOT FOUND | FIND DEVIANT → DEVIANT ATTACKS → OUT OF TIME (CONNOR SHUT DOWN) | RECOVER BIOCOMPONENT → LOSE TOO MUCH TIME (CONNOR AND HANK SURVIVED) | CHASE DEVIANT → RUSH DEVIANT (CONNOR AND HANK SURVIVED) / PROTECT HANK (CONNOR SACRIFICED HIMSELF FOR HANK) / DRAW GUN (MASSACRE PREVENTED). The roof confrontation and the kitchen one each end the chapter. Cross-chapter: Simon found or not (`simon`, `ch24SimonSurvived`), the Jericho memory (`evidence.simonTablet`), the bodies for the evidence room (`evidence.simonBody`, `evidence.kitchenBody`), Connor protected Hank (`ch24ProtectedHank`, Last Chance) and Connor died (`ch24ConnorDied`, Meet Kamski). Researched in docs/research/ch24-public-enemy.md.

decisions.title: Report to Amanda in the Zen Garden
decisions.context: Amanda, in a boat, asks what Connor has discovered, says he seems lost, asks (if he spared the Tracis) why he did not shoot, and threatens to replace him.

options.label: HANK / EDEN CLUB
options.effect: EDEN CLUB: Amanda −1 if the Tracis were not found or escaped, +1 if they died. HANK: none.

options.label: SINCERE / DETERMINED / COLD / TROUBLED
options.effect: SINCERE (spared the Tracis only) Amanda −1; COLD instability −1; TROUBLED instability +1, Amanda −1; DETERMINED none.

options.label: TOO FAR / NO USE / TRUTH
options.effect: Only if the Tracis were spared. TRUTH Amanda −2; the others none.

options.label: CONFLICTED / CONFIDENT / INDIFFERENT
options.effect: CONFLICTED instability +1; CONFIDENT Amanda +1; INDIFFERENT instability −1, Amanda +2.

decisions.gate: Chapter start, after The Stratford Tower. The Traci outcome (The Eden Club) and The Bridge change the lines and the third round.
decisions.note: The template’s arrows win over the wiki’s and PowerPyx’s Amanda arrows on DETERMINED, COLD and TOO FAR.

benchmark.note: An event for the garden and four decision scenes with the game’s buttons and arrows.

decisions.title: Inside Stratford Tower: coin, briefing, corridors, Perkins
decisions.context: Hank confiscates the coin (or apologizes for shooting Connor), Chris briefs them, Connor investigates the corridors and meets Perkins and, if he saved him, the officer from the hostage case.

options.label: LISTEN TO BRIEFING
options.effect: Chris’s briefing, whose lines follow the tower chapter.

options.label: Leave the briefing
options.effect: Only the opening lines.

options.label: Corridor clues
options.effect: Guard next to phone, Simon’s blue blood, dead employee, CCTV, phone, armed guard, each where the tower chapter left it.

decisions.gate: HANK CONFISCATES COIN unless Hank shot Connor in The Bridge (template; PowerPyx adds Friend). MEET COP only if the officer was saved in The Hostage.

benchmark.note: Elevator event, briefing decision, corridor hub with six clues, Perkins and officer events. No stat change.

decisions.title: Investigate the broadcast room; then the roof, the kitchen or leave
decisions.context: Nine clues in the broadcast room (SWAT damage, blood, cap, video, camera, Simon’s body). The camera recording is what unlocks the kitchen accusation.

options.label: Go to the rooftop
options.effect: Clues; with Simon left alive on the roof, finding him ends the chapter.

options.label: Enter the kitchen
options.effect: Interrogate the three station androids.

options.label: Decide to leave (YES)
options.effect: CONNOR AND HANK LEFT THE CRIME SCENE; a hidden Simon survives.

decisions.gate: Leaving is offered once the roof has been inspected (PowerPyx’s objectives; the timer is not modelled). The kitchen can be revisited only after the camera recording.

benchmark.note: A repeatable hub that is also the crossroads; YES/NO with no arrow.

decisions.title: The rooftop and Simon
decisions.context: Door, bag, footprints, weapons, and Simon’s blood or body. If Simon was left alive he is hiding in an air-cooler unit, shoots Connor and is fired on by SWAT.

options.label: RUSH DEVIANT (CHARGE DEVIANT)
options.effect: A risk roll: SHOT BY SIMON → CONNOR DIED RUNNING TOWARD SIMON (instability −1), or REACH SIMON → CONNOR WAS TRAUMATIZED (instability +2; the Jericho memory).

options.label: STAY IN COVER
options.effect: SIMON IS DESTROYED BY SWAT → HANK AND CONNOR SURVIVED UNSCATHED.

options.label: Go back down
options.effect: Simon stays hidden and survives.

decisions.gate: FIND SIMON only if Simon was left alive on the roof in The Stratford Tower.
decisions.note: The death’s instability −1 is the wiki’s; the template shows none (flagged).

benchmark.note: A repeatable roof hub with FIND SIMON as an exit, the CHARGE DEVIANT / STAY IN COVER decision with a 0.3 risk (unsourced), and three ending events.

decisions.title: Interrogate the kitchen androids
decisions.context: Three identical JB300s. FUNCTION / MODEL, then WITNESS / MEMORY / DIAGNOSTIC / CONTACT; with the camera recording, the accusation, THREATEN / DEAL / GUILT, and VIOLENCE / BLUFF / TORTURE / PROBE MEMORY aimed at one android.

options.label: The android on the left (the deviant)
options.effect: FIND DEVIANT → DEVIANT ATTACKS.

options.label: Another android
options.effect: DEVIANT NOT FOUND; Connor and Hank leave.

decisions.gate: The accusation needs CHECK CAMERA; without it Connor must come back.

benchmark.note: Magazines, four rounds with the game’s buttons, a target choice and the deviant’s tell described round by round. No arrow.

decisions.title: The deviant attacks
decisions.context: The deviant pins Connor’s hand with a knife, tears out his regulator and runs.

options.label: REMOVE KNIFE / CALL
options.effect: A risk roll: OUT OF TIME → CONNOR SHUT DOWN (instability −1, Hank −1), or RECOVER BIOCOMPONENT.

options.label: Chase at once or not
options.effect: LOSE TOO MUCH TIME → SWAT DESTROYS DEVIANT → CONNOR AND HANK SURVIVED (no arrow), or CHASE DEVIANT.

benchmark.note: An event, two risky decisions (0.2/0.35 and 0.1, unsourced) and the shutdown ending.

decisions.title: Protect Hank or stop the shooter?
decisions.context: The deviant has a SWAT rifle in a corridor full of police. HANK SURVIVAL PROBABILITY : 40%.

options.label: ATTACK (Rush deviant)
options.effect: DEVIANT SELF-DESTRUCTS → CONNOR AND HANK SURVIVED; public opinion −1, instability +2; the saved officer dies.

options.label: SAVE HANK (Protect Hank)
options.effect: DEVIANT SHOOTS CONNOR → CONNOR SACRIFICED HIMSELF FOR HANK; public opinion −1, Hank +2, instability −1 (death, wiki); the saved officer dies.

options.label: TAKE GUN (Draw gun)
options.effect: SHOOT DEVIANT → MASSACRE PREVENTED; Hank +2; the saved officer is rescued.

decisions.gate: Recover the component and chase the deviant at once.

benchmark.note: One decision with no risk (the chart has one outcome per option) and the corridor endings.
